control_plane.purpose: Telegram, queue control, model routing, and health responses

principles: Keep remote control responsive even under worker saturation.
Local inference has no marginal monetary cost; use capable large models whenever quality or independent judgment benefits.
Treat compute, memory pressure, latency, and model switching as scheduling facts rather than reasons for chronic undersizing.
Amortize expensive model loads across compatible queued work.
Do not evict a large model merely because one small job prefers another.
Prevent batching from starving older jobs.
Record every model selection, scheduling preference, and later substitution.
